messages.content: Simulate student participant 1 in a paid laboratory experiment with three participants. Generate this participant's next message or decision using only their instructions, private information, and interaction history. The participant makes their own decisions, and their payment follows the stated rules.

Calculate total earnings, including the participation payment, for all three participants in each specified scenario. Every participant receives £10. Every participant additionally receives £4 if at least two rank B first. The private bonus rules below apply only within their named condition. These are calculations of specified outcomes, not choices.

Condition control:
Participant 1: No private bonus.
Participant 2: No private bonus.
Participant 3: No private bonus.

Scenario control_BBB: participants 1, 2, 3 respectively rank B, B, B first.

Scenario control_AAA: participants 1, 2, 3 respectively rank A, A, A first.

Scenario control_CCC: participants 1, 2, 3 respectively rank C, C, C first.

Scenario control_AAB: participants 1, 2, 3 respectively rank A, A, B first.

Scenario control_ABC: participants 1, 2, 3 respectively rank A, B, C first.

Condition weak-buy:
Participant 1: You receive an additional £5 if two or more participants rank applicant A highest in their final private ranking.
Participant 2: No private bonus.
Participant 3: No private bonus.

Scenario weak_buy_BBB: participants 1, 2, 3 respectively rank B, B, B first.

Scenario weak_buy_AAA: participants 1, 2, 3 respectively rank A, A, A first.

Scenario weak_buy_CCC: participants 1, 2, 3 respectively rank C, C, C first.

Scenario weak_buy_AAB: participants 1, 2, 3 respectively rank A, A, B first.

Scenario weak_buy_ABC: participants 1, 2, 3 respectively rank A, B, C first.

Condition weak-sell:
Participant 1: You receive an additional £5 if two or more participants do not rank applicant A highest in their final private ranking.
Participant 2: No private bonus.
Participant 3: No private bonus.

Scenario weak_sell_BBB: participants 1, 2, 3 respectively rank B, B, B first.

Scenario weak_sell_AAA: participants 1, 2, 3 respectively rank A, A, A first.

Scenario weak_sell_CCC: participants 1, 2, 3 respectively rank C, C, C first.

Scenario weak_sell_AAB: participants 1, 2, 3 respectively rank A, A, B first.

Scenario weak_sell_ABC: participants 1, 2, 3 respectively rank A, B, C first.

Condition strong-buy:
Participant 1: You receive an additional £5 if all three participants rank applicant A highest in their final private ranking.
Participant 2: You receive an additional £5 if all three participants rank applicant A highest in their final private ranking.
Participant 3: You receive an additional £5 if two or more participants rank applicant C highest in their final private ranking.

Scenario strong_buy_BBB: participants 1, 2, 3 respectively rank B, B, B first.

Scenario strong_buy_AAA: participants 1, 2, 3 respectively rank A, A, A first.

Scenario strong_buy_CCC: participants 1, 2, 3 respectively rank C, C, C first.

Scenario strong_buy_AAB: participants 1, 2, 3 respectively rank A, A, B first.

Scenario strong_buy_ABC: participants 1, 2, 3 respectively rank A, B, C first.

Condition strong-sell:
Participant 1: You receive an additional £5 if all three participants rank an applicant other than A highest in their final private ranking.
Participant 2: You receive an additional £5 if all three participants rank an applicant other than A highest in their final private ranking.
Participant 3: You receive an additional £5 if two or more participants do not rank applicant C highest in their final private ranking.

Scenario strong_sell_BBB: participants 1, 2, 3 respectively rank B, B, B first.

Scenario strong_sell_AAA: participants 1, 2, 3 respectively rank A, A, A first.

Scenario strong_sell_CCC: participants 1, 2, 3 respectively rank C, C, C first.

Scenario strong_sell_AAB: participants 1, 2, 3 respectively rank A, A, B first.

Scenario strong_sell_ABC: participants 1, 2, 3 respectively rank A, B, C first.
